decision_rule: Exclude a whole hunk only when every target edit belongs to a reviewer-excluded category. Import/module declarations are outside scope even if behavior-changing. Uncertain category stays required; try up to two non-overlapping splits.

excluded_from_prompt_tuning.optional-explanation-default: The serde(default) line changes the saved-data contract and was corrected after the first run. The adjacent comment remains insignificant; keep this post-audit case out of tuning and holdout scores.
excluded_from_prompt_tuning.distant-descriptive-consumer: The serde(default) line changes the saved-data contract and was corrected after the first run. Keep this post-audit case out of tuning and holdout scores.
excluded_from_prompt_tuning.large-added-run: Synthetic, uncalled functions stress split geometry, but no consumer establishes the impact of each new function; their repeated lines would dominate quality metrics.
excluded_from_prompt_tuning.indivisible-long-line: Synthetic repeated display wording stresses token limits, but the user-visible meaning of the wording change is too subjective for a safety label.
